abort.already_configured: This PushCloud application is already set up.
abort.wrong_application: That token belongs to a different PushCloud application. Enter a token for this one, or add the other application separately.

error.invalid_auth: That application token was not accepted. Check it has not been rotated.

data_description.token: The new token for this application, from its page in the PushCloud panel.

reauth_confirm.description: The application token is no longer accepted. Enter the current one.
reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate integration

data_description.token: The token beginning pca_, copied from the application's page in the PushCloud panel. One Home Assistant entry sends to one application.

user.description: Notifications are sent to the phones signed in to your PushCloud account.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach PushCloud to list your devices. Try again in a moment.
abort.invalid_auth: PushCloud no longer accepts this application token, so it cannot list your devices. Re-authenticate the integration first.
abort.no_devices: This PushCloud account has no devices yet. Sign in to the PushCloud app on a phone, then come back.

data_description.devices: Tick nothing to notify every device on the account, which is what this entry does today. An automation can still name its own target with 'device' under 'data'.

init.description: Choose which of your devices get notifications from this application.
init.title: Notification devices
